{{Quote|I'm Lord Medechas, leader of Operations Group Five. We started this riot by arming prisoners and pointing them at their Republic captors. But our primary goal is to extract certain inmates held deep within the prison.|Medechas|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Special Operations Group Five''', more commonly known as '''Operations Group Five''', was one of five [[Operations Group|Special Operations Groups]] sent by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] into the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]] in hopes of locating and freeing the [[Dread Masters]]. Group Five was led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Medechas]], and remained behind at the Empire's initial landing point while the others continued deeper into the [[Belsavis prison]]; Medechas' forces established the [[Imperial Lodgement]] as a main base and battled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] security forces under [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Ellis Ruger]].<ref name="TOR" />
